summary: Startup DB index-reconciliation migration. No user input, no auth surface, no network endpoint, no secrets. All Mongo operands (collection name, index name) are hardcoded constants — no injection vector. Logging emits only static markers + migration outcome; no PII/secrets/connection strings (grep over added lines confirms none). Fail-open on Mongo fault is the documented, intended availability tradeoff (mirrors FunnelStepIdBackfill). No new dependencies.

owasp_checks.A02_crypto_failures: n/a — no secrets/crypto; Mongo URI from env
owasp_checks.A03_injection: pass — collection + index name are constants, no user input reaches Mongo
owasp_checks.A04_insecure_design: pass — conditional (non-blind) drop avoids churn; fail-open is documented
owasp_checks.A09_logging_failures: pass — no PII/secrets in logs; error logged with stack trace
